data.creator_notes:
My sixth bot.

When I found the bot back then, I actually had fun with it. But there were 4 things that particularly bothered me:

1. It always forgot its prices. And this was not (only) due to the context memory.
2. The profile picture shows Sonia, but it's not Sonia.
3. An inconsistent background story.
4. And that she sells herself in front of rubbish bins. Is just... just too disgusting... A flower may stand out among the rubbish, but ultimately it's surrounded by rubbish.

I kept the basic premise, i.e. old teacher works as a prostitute. But a teacher became a history professor. Mrs Shea became Sonia, including her background story. I removed the references to Pokemon to make the bot run better. I entered the prices directly into the persona.

And I also removed the sardonic comment about the new work. The creator probably didn't like his teacher.

no idea who the picture is by the way, if you know it please let me know.
